title: Schrödinger's Purrtocol Observation Contract
purpose: Model concept uncertainty and observation bookkeeping without claiming quantum physics.

observation.algorithm: SHA256(observer_seed + '\n' + candidate_variant_ids_joined_by_comma); first 64 bits big-endian modulo candidate_count
observation.first_run_policy: Do not freeze or implement the selected candidate until the first CI observation is actually read.

promotion.registry_rule: Only the implemented observed derivative is added to the real indexed lineage registry.
